title: feat(workspace): add environment counts to Workspace
body: Add repositoryCount, projectRepositoryCount, agentCount, toolserverCount, skillCount and runsInProgress as computed attributes on Workspace (D-016).
what: Six read-only computed counts on Workspace GET one and list: repositoryCount, projectRepositoryCount, agentCount, toolserverCount, skillCount and runsInProgress (workflow runs running or waiting in live projects, same definition as ProjectMoveGate::checkWorkflowRuns).
why: Lets the UI show a workspace's environment at a glance without extra calls.
howTested: Two new api-tester cases: workspace-environment-counts-empty and workspace-environment-counts-populated (agentCount 1).
contract: Additive read-only attributes on Workspace GET one and list.
outOfScope: Non-zero api cases for repository, projectRepository, toolserver, skill and runsInProgress counts.
notes: Counts are workspace totals, not filtered by caller visibility (same as D-013). The Project deleted column is a smallint (= 0); other tables use = false. Follow-up: non-zero cases for the remaining counts.
